notes: The two οὔτε correlatives each keep their own English word (neither, nor); neither is emptied under rules 41 or 59, since the ASV writes a word for each.
The supplied and before report is a rule 88 helper on the finite verb it introduces, παραγενόμενός having been converted into a coordinate finite clause.
Both περί units take their own English preposition under rule 36.
